items.title: Acquire a shared workspace validation capacity lease before story validation
items.context: Existing validationExecutionLockPath is story-scoped, so B-a7c5 and B-9ff1 validations ran concurrently for 20-30 minutes and caused unrelated canonical members to hit unchanged 120/180/300-second limits. Add a worktree-independent capacity mutex keyed by git common dir, acquired before the per-story evidence lock in fixed global→story order. Contention waits with bounded heartbeat progress instead of failing immediately.
items.userSees: A second official validation prints "waiting for workspace validation capacity" with the active holder story/command and heartbeat age, then starts automatically after the first validation releases the lease.
excludes: Do not protect a bare direct npm test invocation; the protected product entrypoints are lattice validate and lattice done_required_validate.
Do not replace the existing per-story evidence serialization lock.

happy.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Hold lattice validate --story=B-cap-a in one linked worktree, start lattice validate --story=B-cap-b in another, and assert B callback entry count stays zero while A holds; B stderr reports waiting for workspace validation capacity with holder story/command and heartbeat age; after A releases, both processes exit 0 automatically and persist distinct PASS evidence. WHY: proves the requested user-visible wait-and-run contract instead of fail-fast contention.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Hold a no-story lattice validate --json, then start story-scoped validate and done_required_validate probes one at a time; assert each waits on the same git-common-dir capacity path and enters only after its predecessor releases. WHY: no-story official validation must not remain a concurrency bypass.

edge.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Keep the first lease alive across at least two heartbeat periods and assert an independent event-loop timer fires, holder heartbeat timestamps advance, and bounded wait progress is emitted without synchronous polling. WHY: an async waiter must not freeze the owner heartbeat and falsely manufacture staleness.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Abort one queued waiter and exhaust another queued wait deadline; assert each exits with the classified abort/deadline result, never enters its validation callback, never acquires the inner story lock, and leaves the active owner untouched. WHY: cancellation must stop before protected work starts.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Nest capacity acquisition in the same AsyncLocal context while a concurrent sibling competes; assert the nested call is reentrant, the sibling remains queued, and both finish after ordered release. WHY: reentrancy must not become process-wide bypass.

adversarial.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Instrument acquisition order and assert every story-scoped official validation acquires workspace capacity before the existing story evidence lock, never the reverse; induce overlapping waiters and assert no deadlock. WHY: fixed global-to-story ordering prevents lock inversion.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Present aged leases owned by a live matching process, an unknown or mismatched active holder, and a proven-dead stale holder; assert live and unknown holders are not stolen and only the proven-dead stale holder is reclaimed before callback entry. WHY: time alone must not authorize takeover.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Run probes in two independent git repositories and in two linked worktrees of one repository; assert independent repositories overlap while linked worktrees serialize through the canonical git-common-dir lease. WHY: coordination scope is workspace identity, not machine-global path or cwd.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Capture stdout and stderr separately for a queued --json validate; JSON.parse every stdout record and assert wait, holder, and heartbeat progress exists only on stderr. WHY: diagnostics must not corrupt machine-readable output.

items.title: Prove cross-story wait-and-run, stale recovery, reentrancy, and release behavior
items.context: Use two different story IDs/worktree roots to prove the second official validation displays live holder/heartbeat diagnostics, does not start its callback while the first lease is held, then automatically acquires after release and succeeds with its own valid evidence. Also verify bounded wait behavior, stale dead-owner reclaim, nested same-context reentrancy, fixed lock ordering, and release after success/throw/signal where applicable.
items.userSees: Two concurrent official validations no longer race: terminal B reports the active holder while waiting, then both terminal A and terminal B end with their own PASS evidence in order.
excludes: Do not treat fail-fast lock contention as success.
Do not accept a proof where the waiting validation never runs after release.

happy.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Launch different-story validate processes A then B against linked worktrees, hold A after callback entry, and assert B emits holder diagnostics without entering; release A and assert terminal order is A PASS evidence then B callback then B PASS evidence, with both children exiting 0. WHY: directly proves wait-and-run and rejects fail-fast or wait-forever implementations.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Hold lattice validate for story A, queue lattice done_required_validate for story B, then reverse the roles; assert both entrypoint pairs serialize and each command writes its own expected evidence artifact only after its callback runs. WHY: both official gates must consume one shared capacity mechanism.

edge.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Exercise owner callback success and throw paths with a queued successor; assert the lease directory is released in finally, the successor enters exactly once, and the thrown owner result remains a failure rather than being converted to PASS. WHY: cleanup must preserve command truth.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Terminate a child owner after it acquires capacity, retain a queued child, and assert the queued child does not enter while ownership is live, reclaims only after dead-holder classification and stale policy allow it, then exits 0 without orphan lock files. WHY: abrupt process loss must converge safely.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Hold one owner while three independent waiters queue; assert sampled max concurrent callback count is exactly one, every non-aborted waiter eventually runs after successive releases, and progress output is rate-bounded rather than emitted per poll. WHY: serialization must not trade races for starvation or log flooding.

adversarial.desc: Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Delay story A after validation command exit but before evidence persistence and start story B; assert B cannot enter capacity until A persistence finishes and A evidence cannot overwrite B evidence afterward. WHY: the capacity lease must cover the complete official evidence critical section, not only child execution.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Run a same-story nested validation from the owning AsyncLocal context and a same-story independent process concurrently; assert only the true nested call is reentrant, the independent process queues, and the existing per-story evidence lock is still acquired inside capacity. WHY: preserving the inner lock must not permit sibling-context bypass.

Command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-execution-lock-smoke.js --workspace-capacity-contract-only. Seed malformed, mismatched-start-time, and fresh unknown holder records and assert the test never deletes a holder unless the shared classifier proves reclaimable; all refused takeovers keep callback entry count zero. WHY: hostile or partial metadata must fail closed.

items.title: Prove official validation gates retain their existing commands and budgets
items.context: Both lattice validate and lattice done_required_validate must consume the workspace capacity lease without changing configured command inventories, per-command timeouts, root full-suite 120/300-second proof thresholds, evidence bindings, or direct read-only commands. Document and test that a bare npm test/full-suite invocation bypasses this official coordination boundary and therefore must not be run concurrently with official validation.
items.userSees: Official validate and done_required_validate retain their existing PASS output and evidence, while help/diagnostics state that bare npm test is outside the workspace lease boundary.
excludes: Do not wrap or alter bare npm test in this Story.
Do not change any validation command, member timeout, suite threshold, or evidence freshness rule.
